description: This file defines classes and enums for managing deferred command graph construction and execution in Vulkan within the ANGLE project. It includes classes for command graph nodes, resources, and dependency management, facilitating reordering and optimization of Vulkan commands derived from OpenGL calls.

classes.name: RenderPassOwner
classes.description: Manages notifications when a render pass command buffer finishes recording.

classes.name: CommandGraphNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Vulkan command graph, encapsulating commands, dependencies, and diagnostic info.

classes.name: CommandGraphResource
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan resource used within the command graph, managing dependencies and command recording.

classes.name: CommandGraph
classes.description: Manages the collection of command graph nodes, dependencies, and submission for deferred Vulkan command execution.

classes.name: ResourceUse
classes.description: Tracks how a resource is used in the command graph and queue, including reference count and last serial.

classes.name: SharedResourceUse
classes.description: Smart wrapper around ResourceUse, managing lifetime and serial updates.

classes.name: SharedGarbage
classes.description: Manages deferred deletion of Vulkan objects associated with resources, based on serial completion.
